teaser.en: Before a wedding or at Eid, hands and feet across the coast are painted orange-red with the crushed leaves of this shrub.
teaser.sw: Kabla ya harusi au wakati wa Idi, mikono na miguu kote pwani hupakwa rangi nyekundu ya chungwa kwa majani yaliyopondwa ya kichaka hiki.

summary.en: *Hina* is henna, a shrub planted around homes whose dried leaves give an orange-red dye. It decorates hands, feet and hair for weddings and Eid, and is also used for perfume, medicine and love charms.
summary.sw: *Hina* ni mhina, kichaka kinachopandwa kuzunguka nyumba ambacho majani yake yaliyokaushwa hutoa rangi nyekundu ya chungwa. Hupamba mikono, miguu na nywele wakati wa harusi na Idi, na pia hutumika kwa manukato, dawa na hirizi za mapenzi.

about.en:
*Hina* is a much-branched shrub or small tree with small, smooth, oval leaves in opposite pairs. Its small flowers, white to pinkish, grow in loose sprays and are strongly fragrant. The fruits are small round capsules.

The colour is hidden in the leaves: dried and ground into a green powder, then mixed into a paste, they stain skin and hair a lasting orange-red.
about.sw:
*Hina* ni kichaka chenye matawi mengi au mti mdogo, wenye majani madogo, laini, ya umbo la yai, yaliyo jozi zinazotazamana. Maua yake madogo, meupe hadi ya waridi, huota kwa mashada yaliyolegea na yana harufu kali nzuri. Matunda yake ni vibuyu vidogo vya mviringo.

Rangi imejificha kwenye majani: yakikaushwa na kusagwa kuwa unga wa kijani, kisha kuchanganywa kuwa uji mzito, hupaka ngozi na nywele rangi nyekundu ya chungwa inayodumu.

where.en: Henna is planted around homes on the south coast.
where.sw: Mhina hupandwa kuzunguka nyumba pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The leaves are made into a dye for hands, feet and hair, especially for weddings and Eid. The fragrant flowers are used to make perfume, and the plant is also used in medicine.
uses.sw: Majani yake hutengenezwa rangi ya kupaka mikono, miguu na nywele, hasa wakati wa harusi na Idi. Maua yake yenye harufu nzuri hutumika kutengeneza manukato, na mmea huu pia hutumika kama dawa.

culture.en: Henna is part of celebration on the coast, worn at weddings and at Eid. It is also used in love magic: henna extract is used for romantic attraction, a practice known as *maruwa*.
culture.sw: Hina ni sehemu ya sherehe pwani, hupakwa wakati wa harusi na Idi. Pia hutumika katika uchawi wa mapenzi: dondoo la hina hutumika kuvuta mapenzi, desturi inayojulikana kama *maruwa*.

names.en: The Digo name is *hina*. Swahili calls the plant *mhina* or *mkokoa*, and the powder *hina*. In Bajun it is *mvuma nyuki*. In English it is henna.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *hina*. Kwa Kiswahili mmea huitwa *mhina* au *mkokoa*, na unga wake huitwa *hina*. Kwa Kibajuni huitwa *mvuma nyuki*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *henna*.

reason.sw: Manjano, mmea mwingine unaotumika kwa rangi na urembo

reason.en: Another homestead plant with a spiritual use
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa nyumbani wenye matumizi ya kiroho
